My Story

Hi, I'm Hedda.

I grew up in Norway with a loving family and every reason to feel secure — and yet for a long time, I had no idea who I actually was beneath the version of myself I'd built for everyone else.

I didn't realise how much I needed to please others and be "perfect" until I started asking a simple question: what do I actually want?

For years I was driven by validation. By being easy, agreeable, and whatever each situation seemed to need from me. It felt like a strength — until I found myself in countries and situations that stripped away all my familiar contexts, and I had to face what was left.

Living in Indonesia, Australia, Spain, Denmark, Brazil — each place cracked me open a little more. Being outside my comfort zone again and again taught me things no classroom could. I started learning through experience. Through discomfort. Through choosing myself, even when it was terrifying.

I'm not driven by validation anymore. I'm driven by curiosity, purpose, and growth. And I built the Self Trust Club to help you find the same.

Norway → World Curiosity Purpose Growth Authenticity

My Mission

"To help people move from self-doubt to self-trust so they can stop shrinking themselves and start living with honesty, courage, and authenticity."
